description: This plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for six different model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 145,000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. All six lines are solid without markers, feature a lighter semi-transparent shaded region of the corresponding color, and exhibit a steep initial decline from above the y-axis maximum of 3.4 near iteration 0, followed by a gradual, steady decrease through the remainder of the plot. The blue solid line, representing "StrmLLM (n=64)," remains the highest throughout the gradual decline phase, ending at approximately 2.62. The orange solid line, representing "SepLLM (n=64)," ends at approximately 2.52. The green solid line, representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)," ends slightly lower at approximately 2.51. The dark blue solid line, representing "SepLLM (n=128)," ends at approximately 2.50. The red solid line, representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," ends at approximately 2.49. Finally, the purple solid line, representing "Vanilla," ends at the lowest value of approximately 2.46 at the final iteration.
